narratives.body: LiveScore discusses a reported move for Tresoldi involving AC Milan and Arsenal with a 60 million figure as early as January.
narratives.headline: Tresoldi: transfer reports

narratives.body: 조선일보 reports that AC Milan collapsed 0-3 in the Europa League after Maignan received a red card. LiveScore reports that Bournemouth defeated AC Milan 3-0 in the Europa League after the goalkeeper was sent off. TNT Sports notes that Milan forgot to make a substitution after Maignan saw red, described as 'absolutely farcical'.
narratives.headline: AC Milan: Europa League collapse

narratives.body: LiveScore quotes Pavlovic stating Milan 'are on the right track' even if 'too many mistakes' were made.
narratives.headline: Pavlovic: team progress opinion
